title: First Unique IP Hitting the Server
statementHtml:
Problem statement

Your server receives a stream of IP hit events. Design a data structure that supports two operations:

  • ADD ip: record one hit from ip
  • FIRST_UNIQUE: return the earliest IP address that has appeared exactly once so far, or an empty string if none exists

Process all commands in order and return the outputs produced by the FIRST_UNIQUE commands.
statementText: Problem statement Your server receives a stream of IP hit events. Design a data structure that supports two operations: ADD ip : record one hit from ip FIRST_UNIQUE : return the earliest IP address that has appeared exactly once so far, or an empty string if none exists Process all commands in order and return the outputs produced by the FIRST_UNIQUE commands.
constraints: The total number of events can be as large as 10^7.
The number of distinct IPs can be as large as 10^6.
IP strings should be treated as opaque strings; validation is not required.
